changes: p3 name: dropped the honorific śrī ('Śrīkṛṣṇa' → 'Kṛṣṇa'); the abbreviated title is recorded as 'jyotiṣī (jyoºº)'.
p3 evidence and notes: 'puºº' is most likely pustakam, which makes Kṛṣṇa the owner. A reading as putra or purohita cannot be ruled out, so confidence stays medium.
p2: 'maṃḍalīkaraṇē' is kept as a provisional title. The notes add that it could instead be a locative place name, meaning 'at Maṇḍalīkaraṇa'.
p1: evidence shortened; Bhāskararāya is the commentator (author of the bhāṣya), not connected with this copy.
date: the weekday and month were checked; the notes explain which month scheme fits.
purpose: rendered as a dedication at the guru's feet.

notes: The text is Bhāskararāya's bhāṣya on the Tripuramahopaniṣad. 'maṃḍalīkaraṇē' after the scribe's name is unclear: it could be a caste or office designation (Karaṇa), an epithet, or the locative of a place name. 'puºº' most likely abbreviates pustakam, which would make Śrīkṛṣṇa jyo(tiṣī) the owner; putra or purohita are possible but less likely readings. 'jyoºº' could stand for jyotiṣī or jyotirvid. Date: VS 1970 = 1913 CE. A rough calculation suggests the Thursday weekday fits Bhādrapada kṛṣṇa 2 in the amānta scheme, about 18 September 1913. In the pūrṇimānta scheme the day would fall about 18–19 August 1913, a Monday or Tuesday. This is approximate and has not been checked against a pañcāṅga. The catalogue's scribe field 'Gopīnātha maṃḍalīkaraṇe' matches the colophon. The verse 'bhagnapṛṣṭhakaṭigrīvā...' is the standard scribal formula.
